subject: Quick thought on Gotmefit's digital presence and platform
body: Hi Gotmefit Team, I came across Gotmefit while looking into fitness platforms in Raipur and really appreciate your focus on empowering individuals through personalized wellness routines and comprehensive tracking. While browsing your current site, I noticed a couple of missed opportunities, such as limited prominent contact options and missing meta descriptions that could help with local search visibility. To see how these could be streamlined, I went ahead and put together a modern, live prototype for you featuring a clean bento grid layout, a more direct hero call-to-action, and clear booking paths. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x3a28dd14c41e6695-0xb2bce0e892d9848-tzhkc2sgt.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added prominent contact options and support pathways
Refined primary hero CTA messaging for higher conversion
Improved local search visibility with structured markup and descriptions
